decisions.reason: The cobot loading system extends the firm's core machining and automation know-how, so its in-house R&D can read early results and refine the product, in line with its strategy of smarter automation.
The dual-table loading system builds directly on the established machine offer, giving the firm strong related knowledge to assimilate market feedback and improve it.

Dispensing lies further from the core offer, but the firm's own R&D and existing dispensing activities provide some related knowledge, and the dedicated page and Red Dot award show commitment, so it is kept despite a higher risk.
